text: Diwali is the festival of lights celebrated across India. It symbolizes the victory of light over darkness and good over evil. It is associated with Lord Rama's return to Ayodhya after 14 years of exile.
Guru Purnima is a festival dedicated to teachers and spiritual guides. It marks the birth anniversary of Sage Vyasa, the author of the Mahabharata.
Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating in Tamil Nadu. It combines expressions, rhythm, and storytelling to depict mythological themes.
